results.content: # GAME ME-ICC | Back pain can occur with Myalgic Encephalomyelitis (ME), and it often reflects the underlying inflammation of the brain and spinal cord (the “enceph... Back pain can occur with Myalgic Encephalomyelitis (ME), and it often reflects the underlying inflammation of the brain and spinal cord (the “encephalo-myelitis” in the name). The pain tends to have specific features, and it may overlap with muscular, neurological, and connective tissue dysfunctions. Mechanisms of Back Pain in ME. The myelitis part of ME indicates inflammation in the spinal cord. This can cause axial pain (pain along the spine) and stiffness, sometimes described as deep or burning. → Describes spinal pain and tenderness as part of the neurological features of ME. → Notes pain in the back and spine as part of inflammatory involvement of the CNS. *Includes back pain and spinal tenderness as part of the neurological/musculoskeletal manifestations. Reviews evidence for spinal cord inflammation and pain in ME.
